Using the sum and constant factor rules, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int (5(\sqrt{x})^{3}-4{x}^{2}+5)\,\text{d}x & =\int (5{x}^{3/2}-4{x}^{2}+5)\,\text{d}x \\  & =5\int {x}^{3/2}\,\text{d}x-4\int {x}^{2}\text{d}x+5\int 1\,\text{d}x \\  & =5(\frac{{x}^{5/2}}{\frac{5}{2}})-4(\frac{{x}^{3}}{3})+5(x)+C \\  & =5\cdot \frac{2}{5}{x}^{5/2}-\frac{4}{3}{x}^{3}+5x+C \\  & =2\sqrt{{x}^{5}}-\frac{4}{3}{x}^{3}+5x+C.\end{aligned}
$$
